figs.name: lighting-design-calculation-lumen-method-steps-flowchart
figs.alt: lighting design calculation flowchart of the lumen method steps with worked values
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the seven lumen method steps, from 500 lux and 200 square metres to room index 3.03 and 54 fixtures.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Lumen method lighting design calculation step by step flowchart</title>
<rect width="800" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Lumen Method in 7 Steps</text>
<circle cx="62" cy="87" r="20" fill="#7c3aed"/>
<text x="62" y="94" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
<rect x="96" y="60" width="330" height="54" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="112" y="83" font-size="18" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Required lux level E</text>
<text x="112" y="105" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">open plan office</text>
<line x1="428" y1="87" x2="470" y2="87" stroke="#4c1d95" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="472" y="64" width="300" height="46" rx="23" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="622" y="94" font-size="18" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">E = 500 lux</text>
<line x1="62" y1="108" x2="62" y2="128" stroke="#4c1d95" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<circle cx="62" cy="157" r="20" fill="#7c3aed"/>
<text x="62" y="164" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
<rect x="96" y="130" width="330" height="54" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="112" y="153" font-size="18" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Room area A</text>
<text x="112" y="175" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">length × width</text>
<line x1="428" y1="157" x2="470" y2="157" stroke="#4c1d95" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="472" y="134" width="300" height="46" rx="23" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="622" y="164" font-size="18" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">A = 20 × 10 = 200 m²</text>
<line x1="62" y1="178" x2="62" y2="198" stroke="#4c1d95" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<circle cx="62" cy="227" r="20" fill="#7c3aed"/>
<text x="62" y="234" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3</text>
<rect x="96" y="200" width="330" height="54" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="112" y="223" font-size="18" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Flux per fixture F</text>
<text x="112" y="245" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">fixture data sheet</text>
<line x1="428" y1="227" x2="470" y2="227" stroke="#4c1d95" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="472" y="204" width="300" height="46" rx="23" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="622" y="234" font-size="18" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">F = 3600 lm (40 W LED)</text>
<line x1="62" y1="248" x2="62" y2="268" stroke="#4c1d95" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<circle cx="62" cy="297" r="20" fill="#7c3aed"/>
<text x="62" y="304" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4</text>
<rect x="96" y="270" width="330" height="54" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="112" y="293" font-size="18" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Room index RI</text>
<text x="112" y="315" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">from L, W and Hm</text>
<line x1="428" y1="297" x2="470" y2="297" stroke="#4c1d95" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="472" y="274" width="300" height="46" rx="23" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="622" y="304" font-size="18" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">RI = 200 ÷ 66 = 3.03</text>
<line x1="62" y1="318" x2="62" y2="338" stroke="#4c1d95" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<circle cx="62" cy="367" r="20" fill="#7c3aed"/>
<text x="62" y="374" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">5</text>
<rect x="96" y="340" width="330" height="54" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="112" y="363" font-size="18" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Utilisation factor UF</text>
<text x="112" y="385" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">photometric table</text>
<line x1="428" y1="367" x2="470" y2="367" stroke="#4c1d95" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="472" y="344" width="300" height="46" rx="23" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="622" y="374" font-size="18" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">UF = 0.65</text>
<line x1="62" y1="388" x2="62" y2="408" stroke="#4c1d95" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<circle cx="62" cy="437" r="20" fill="#7c3aed"/>
<text x="62" y="444" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">6</text>
<rect x="96" y="410" width="330" height="54" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="112" y="433" font-size="18" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Maintenance factor MF</text>
<text x="112" y="455" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">clean office</text>
<line x1="428" y1="437" x2="470" y2="437" stroke="#4c1d95" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="472" y="414" width="300" height="46" rx="23" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="622" y="444" font-size="18" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">MF = 0.8</text>
<line x1="62" y1="458" x2="62" y2="478" stroke="#4c1d95" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<circle cx="62" cy="507" r="20" fill="#7c3aed"/>
<text x="62" y="514" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">7</text>
<rect x="96" y="480" width="330" height="54" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="112" y="503" font-size="18" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">N = (E × A) ÷ (F × UF × MF)</text>
<text x="112" y="525" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">round up</text>
<line x1="428" y1="507" x2="470" y2="507" stroke="#4c1d95" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="472" y="484" width="300" height="46" rx="23" fill="#7c3aed" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="622" y="514" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">N = 53.4, so 54</text>
<text x="400" y="575" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Arrange 54 fixtures as 6 rows × 9 columns for a symmetric layout</text>
</svg>
